summary: Fence managed OMP tools and mailbox delivery with incarnation-owned idle refresh admission

rules.detail: The managed OMP extension closes admission only with native idle, zero admitted tools and handoffs, and a subsequent zero running-job snapshot in one synchronous boundary. Closed tools and native shell/Python execution are visibly refused, as is mailbox delivery. Native user execution without proven completion makes that incarnation unsupported.

compatibility.detail: Native user or RPC text turns may still start after closure, but cannot execute tools; native resume preserves transcript input. Other adapters remain unsupported. No controller actuation or automatic refresh enablement is added.

recovery.detail: A closed gate survives channel reconnects and only its exact incarnation, owner sequence and epoch can reopen it. Tool accounting errors prevent refresh closure. Nested dispatches sharing a call ID are counted separately; explicit denials and matching terminal tool-result messages settle dispatches without clearing live nested work. Ambiguous completion stays busy.
